rows.note: This is the all-purpose construction for something located on or relating to the left side.

example.jyutping: nei5 gaan2 zo2 bin1 ge3 wai2 laa1

rows.note: Use this for an object designed for use with the left hand, such as left-handed scissors.

example.english: These left-hand scissors are very comfortable to use.
example.traditional: 呢把左手用嘅剪刀好順手。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 zo2 sau2 jung6 ge3 zin2 dou1 hou2 seon6 sau2

rows.jyutping: gwaan6 jung6 zo2 sau2 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for a person who habitually uses the left hand, such as a left-handed bowler.

example.english: My older brother is a left-hand bowler.
example.traditional: 我阿哥係慣用左手嘅保齡球手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 go1 hai6 gwaan6 jung6 zo2 sau2 ge3 bou2 ling4 kau4 sau2
